unsupported: The member-owned cooperative has served the telecommunications needs of northwest North Dakota for decades, though a specific founding year is not publicly disclosed.
Organized as a cooperative, it returns capital credits to its members and reinvests in local infrastructure.
Service is delivered over a fiber and fixed-wireless network covering the cooperative's service territory.
Customers range from rural households and farms to small businesses, schools, and community institutions across the region.
Capital credits allocate margins back to members, reinforcing the member-owned model.

Known for: Delivered with a handshake and a smile; Member-owned cooperative returning capital credits; Local offices in Ray and Williston; Participation in Foundation for Rural Service grant programs; Community scholarships and sponsorship programs
